facts.text: Undergraduate theology seminarians at Hellenic College are required to complete a Minor in Modern Greek Language and Culture, which qualifies them to complete the Holy Cross M.Div. in three years rather than four.

sources.title: Theology - Hellenic College Holy Cross
sources.quote: Now seminarians are required to complete a Minor in Modern Greek Language & Culture. This Minor ensures that students entering into the MDiv program will be able to complete the MDiv within three years, instead of the typical four years.
